BiblicalUsage: Karowz is a herald — the crier who proclaims the king's command aloud. Then an herald cried aloud: to you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages, that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the herald's cry is the test of the hour: bow to the image or burn in the furnace — and the three friends chose the furnace, because they served a greater King.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
